component.name: QC: Doom Edition
component.summary: “QC: Doom Edition” is a mod that brings the weapons from the latest Quake game, into Doom, with delicious pixelated flavor.

description.p: “QC: Doom Edition” is a mod that brings the weapons from the latest Quake game, into Doom, with delicious pixelated flavor. More than just weapons, it also brings the “Champions” mechanic -- different player classes, each one with unique status, speed, active and passive abilities.

MAIN FEATURES
All weapons from Quake Champions, with faithful firing times for best transferable experience
Weapon upgrades that give each weapon a whole new role
33 champions to play, each with unique abilities
Play Single Player, Cooperative, Survival, Deathmatch, CTF, and more!
Monster sets to mix and match: Doom, Doom 4, Quake, Quake 2, Quake 4
Runs on Q-Zandronum, a fork of Zandronum with additions for QC:DE
Older versions are also available for GZDoom (1.9.1 and above), Zandronum (3.0 and above) and Delta Touch.
Enhanced Deathmatch bots for both local and public use
QCDEmaps: a set of 75 QCDE-specific maps, including both original and demakes from QC, Q1, Q3, Q4, QL, Doom 4, and more!
Optional soundtrack by Michael Markie with original songs and covers of well-known favorites
Comes with optional addons that add Unreal Tournament weapons, movement and soundtrack
Damage numbers, speedometer, in-game champion info screens, and tons of customization with very sane defaults
Lootboxes! For free!
And more!

ul.li: Reverted the quake explosion thrust formula when hit by other players.
Fixed Zedek and Postal ability graphics.
Changed Kane ability screen blend from blue to orange.
Added automap markers for weapons and powerups in PvP.
The explosion knockback on players is calculated relative to their eyes, no matter who fired the projectile. Previously, it only worked when receiving knockback from own projectiles.
"callvote" command now also automatically votes "yes".
Made rocket/nail boosts on high ping slightly less jittery.
Added bot variations from Combalance addon.
Updated bots AI. They can now chase the player sometimes. Also they can now follow the player in PvE.
Increased Doom Movement champions ground speed.
Orbb drone is now solid, so it can block other players, and can be used as an air platform to navigate the map.
Orbb drone now has 100 health and can be destroyed.
Pressing attack button while controlling Orbb drone turns it into a controllable missile that rushes forward and explodes on impact.
Increased Orbb drone explosion damage in PvP from 85 to 100.
Increased Orbb overbounce retain velocity from 82% to 85%.
Grayson ability no longer freezes players movement.
Galen totems heal refill in PvP when a new totem is thrown.
Reduced Galen ability PvP cooldown from 35 to 30 seconds.
Corvus flight now only boosts speed by 16% instead of 42%.
Corvus now receives 25% more damage when in flight.
Menelkir's Maulotaur no longer does the ground flame attack.
Menelkir's Maulotaur is now more aggressive. He moves faster and charges into enemies if they are nearby.
Enemies killed by Menelkir or Maulotaur now prolong Maulotaur's life.
Nerfed Ranger orb damage in PvP.
Ranger can't teleport for a short while after throwing the orb.
Doomslayer BFG fires faster in PvP.
Reduced Doomslayer ability cooldown in PvP to 40 seconds.
Increased Painkiller demon form speed.
Increased Painkiller demon form projectile speed in PvP.
Painkiller can now cancel his demon form immediately by pressing active ability button.
Zedek stomp deals less damage, but launches enemies upward.
Lucienne now drops her immolation ball in PvE when falling to 30 hp instead of on death. To recharge the passive, heal back to 100 hp.
Reduced Kane crouch slide speed and Injection speed boost.
Reduced Durandal and Intruder air acceleration.
Removed speed cap from CPM champions in PvE.
Reduced Shotgun bullet spread.
Nailgun ammo pickups give 50 nails.
UT Dispersion Pistol upgrades no longer reduce fire rate.
Changed Kane sprites to a stroggified variant.
Updated all Quake 4 weapon skin sprites.
Updated all Quake Wars: Enemy Territory weapon skin sprites, except SNG.
Updated Quake 3 HMG, SNG and BFG skin sprites.
Updated Quake 2 Gauntlet, Nailgun, LG and BFG skin sprites.
Updates Serious Sam MG, SNG, LG, RG and BFG skin sprites.
Added Quake Live HMG as the Quake 3 Machinegun skin.
Added Quake 3 Team Arena nailgun as the Quake 3 Shotgun skin.
Updated green BFG projectile sprites.
Updated graphics for Default BFG, Half-Life HMG, Half-Life BFG and Serious Sam BFG skins.
Updated graphics for hourglasses, automap pickup, rad suit pickup, protection powerup.
Updated graphics for all weapon upgrades.
Updated scope graphics for Quake 4, Quake World and Serious Sam Railgun skin scopes.
Updated weapons HUD sprites.
Added fire sprites to Painkiller gauntlet when upgraded in PvE.
Added HUD graphics for Painkiller gauntlet.
Updated Postal smoke sprites.
Updated Zedek flame sprites.
Picked more suitable weapon skins for sets that lack skins in some slots when using class based skins.
Updated ability graphics for Bitterman, DoomSlayer, Galen, Grayson, Kane, Keel, Lucienne, Major.
Updated cursor graphic. You can select the old cursor in settings if you wish.
Redone all UT weapons sprites.
Fixed wrong menu scaling on resolutions other than 1920x1080. Now all menu elements should be properly visible on all screens.
Fixed issue when Galen totems won't play heal sound in multiplayer sometimes.
All changes since 2.7 are documented in the included changelog
